city_model.name: Emmer-Compascuum (full woonplaats, with solar panels)
city_model.description: Emmer-Compascuum woonplaats (full settlement within the municipality of Emmen): BAG + 3DBAG LoD 0/1/2 + EP-online energy labels, clipped to the BAG woonplaats boundary, extended with solar panel polygons from the University of Groningen aerial-imagery dataset (Zenodo 14860030, CC-BY-4.0). Same inclusion criteria as the emmer-compascuum.gml LoD0 build but with LoD2 roofs so solar panels can be projected as nrg3:GenericSolarCollector features. The woonplaats bbox fully contains the solar dataset extent (1451 ha), so this build captures the whole panel population rather than the ~7% inside the small-area AOI. Source for the solar-panel-area-per-EP-online-label figure.
